 def _parse_annotation(annotation: str, env: BuildEnvironment = None) -> List[Node]:
     """Parse type annotation."""
+    def is_literal(node: ast.AST) -> bool:
+        """Check whether the node is a ``Literal`` annotation (ex. ``Literal``, ``typing.Literal``)."""
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            return node.id == 'Literal'
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
+            return node.attr == 'Literal'
+        else:
+            return False
+
+    def get_source(node: ast.AST) -> str:
+        """Get source code from an AST node."""
+        if not hasattr(node, 'end_col_offset'):
+            raise AttributeError  # old ast modules (ex. py3.7 and below)
+        lines = annotation.splitlines()
+        if node.lineno == node.end_lineno:
+            return lines[node.lineno - 1][node.col_offset:node.end_col_offset]
+        else:
+            # the node spans multiple lines (ex. a long string literal)
+            first = lines[node.lineno - 1][node.col_offset:]
+            last = lines[node.end_lineno - 1][:node.end_col_offset]
+            return '\n'.join([first] + lines[node.lineno - 1:node.end_lineno - 1] + [last])
+
+    literal_values: List[Node] = []  # Text nodes that must not be cross referenced (refs: #9726)
+
+    def unparse_literal_slice(node: ast.AST) -> List[Node]:
+        """Unparse a slice of a ``Literal`` annotation.
+
+        The values of a ``Literal`` annotation are not types, so they are rendered
+        as plain text instead of cross references (refs: #9726).
+        """
+        def to_text(node: ast.AST) -> nodes.Text:
+            text = nodes.Text(get_source(node))
+            literal_values.append(text)
+            return text
+
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Index):
+            return unparse_literal_slice(node.value)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Tuple):
+            result = []
+            for elem in node.elts:
+                result.append(to_text(elem))
+                result.append(addnodes.desc_sig_punctuation('', ', '))
+            if result:
+                result.pop()
+            return result
+        else:
+            return [to_text(node)]
+
     def unparse(node: ast.AST) -> List[Node]:
         if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
             return [nodes.Text("%s.%s" % (unparse(node.value)[0], node.attr))]
